alerts.headline: Frost Advisory issued October 10 at 12:50PM PDT until October 12 at 8:00AM PDT by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures as low as 30 to 36 degrees Monday morning could
result in frost formation.

* WHERE...Northern Hood Canal, Northern Washington Coast, Southern
Hood Canal, Lowlands of Lewis and Southern Thurston Counties,
Lowlands of Pierce and Southern King Counties, Olympia and Southern
Puget Sound, and Willapa and Black Hills.

* WHEN...From midnight Sunday Night to 8 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Frost could harm sensitive outdoor vegetation. Sensitive
outdoor plants may be killed if left uncovered.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.

alerts.headline: Lake Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 1:15AM PDT until October 10 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph. Waves
2 to 3 feet on Lake Tahoe and Pyramid Lake.

* WHERE...Greater Lake Tahoe Area, Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden
Area, and Western Nevada Basin and Range including Pyramid Lake.

* WHEN...From 5 AM early this morning to 11 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds and rough waves on area lakes will create
hazardous conditions for small craft.

alerts.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 10 at 1:12AM PDT until October 10 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zones 274 Southern Mono County, 420
Northern Sierra Front including Carson City, Douglas, Storey,
Southern Washoe, Western Lyon, and Far Southern Lassen Counties,
421 Southern Sierra Front including Alpine, Northern Mono, Southern
Lyon, and Western Mineral Counties, 423 West Humboldt Basin in
Pershing County, and 429 Lahontan Basin including Churchill and
Eastern Mineral Counties.

* TIMING...From 11 AM this morning to 9 PM PDT this evening.

* WINDS...Southwest winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts 35 to 45 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Minimum Humidity between 14 to 22 percent.

* DURATION...3 to 6 hours.

* IMPACTS...The combination of gusty winds and prolonged dry
conditions, even in areas where humidity may not be as low, can
cause fires to rapidly grow in size and intensity before first
responders can contain them.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 10 at 12:58PM PDT until October 12 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...In California, Death Valley National Park. In Nevada,
Esmeralda and Central Nye County and Western Clark and Southern Nye
County.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

alerts.headline: Flood Watch issued October 10 at 10:58AM PDT until October 12 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast California, including the following
areas, Death Valley National Park and Western Mojave Desert and
south central Nevada, including the following area, Esmeralda and
Central Nye County.

* WHEN...From 5 PM PDT this afternoon through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas. Low-water
crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Incoming tropical moisture will lead to widespread shower and
thunderstorm activity, some of which may cause flash flooding.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
